newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Australian XI 49 for none v West Indies.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Australian XI 49 for none v West Indies.

text.p: An Australian XI were 49 without loss at lunch on the first day of a tour match against West Indies at Bellerive Oval on Friday.
Lunch was called early after rain interrupted play during the first session of the four-day match.
Opening batsman Matthew Hayden gave the West Indian bowlers three chances but survived to be 14 not out at the interval.
Fellow opener Matthew Elliott was in good form to reach 27, including three boundaries from pull shots.
Australian XI captain Stuart Law won the toss and chose to bat, with star batsman Brian Lara captaining West Indies in the absence of Courtney Walsh.
West Indies - Robert Samuels, Sherwin Campbell, Brian Lara (captain), Shivnarine Chanderpaul, Carl Hooper, Jimmy Adams, Roland Holder, Courtney Browne, Nixon McLean, Patterson Thompson, Ian Bishop.
Australian XI - Matthew Hayden, Matthew Elliott, Greg Blewett, Stuart Law (captain), Michael Bevan, Darren Lehmann, Adam Gilchrist, Brad Hogg, Andrew Bichel, Anthony Stuart, Jason Gillespie.
